resources.string: Ukuze uqede isifundo, swayiphela phezulu ngeminwe emi-3, bese uthola inketho yokuqeda isifundo
Imenyu yezinketho ivuliwe. Manje ungasebenzisa ukuthinta okujwayelekile kwe-SandFly ukuze uzulazule. Swayiphela kwesokudla ukuze ubone ezinye izinketho.
Ngekhibhodi ye-braille, ungathepha isikrini ukuze ufake i-braille yamachashazi angu-6.\n\nUsebenzisa i-Unified English Braille. Ukuze ushintshe ulimi lokufaka, iya ku-Amasethingi weSandFly.
Umunwe wakho wokukhomba wesobunxele kufanele ube kuchashazi 1. Manje, thepha ichashazi 1 ukuze uthayiphe uhlamvu “A”.
